coupons.description: Verified U.S. college students get Hulu (With Ads) for $1.99/month as long as enrollment status remains verified, then the regular monthly price. Verified via SheerID.

coupons.title: Students 50% off for first 12 months
coupons.description: Students get 50% off any Paramount+ plan for their first 12 months after verifying status through SheerID. New subscribers also get a standard 7-day free trial.

coupons.title: Streaming: $1 for first 3 months
coupons.description: New subscribers get SiriusXM streaming for $1 for the first 3 months, then $4/month. Auto-renews at the then-current rate unless cancelled.

coupons.title: Premium Individual: 3 months free
coupons.description: New Premium users get 3 months free, then $12.99/month. Available only to people who have not previously tried Premium.
coupons.eligibility: New subscribers who never had Premium

coupons.title: Student plan ~$7.99/month
coupons.description: Eligible students get YouTube Premium for roughly half price (about $7.99/month in the US) after verifying enrollment through SheerID. Renewable annually for up to four years while enrolled.

coupons.title: 10% off select stays with free Genius membership
coupons.description: Create a free Booking.com account to unlock Genius Level 1 and get 10% discounts on select stays and rental cars worldwide, applied automatically on Genius-labeled properties.

coupons.title: Up to $40 off flight fees with code AIR40
coupons.description: Apply code AIR40 at checkout to save up to $40 off booking fees on flights at CheapOair.

coupons.title: 10%+ off hotels with free One Key membership
coupons.description: Join One Key for free to access member-only prices of 10% or more off on over 100,000 hotels, with no code required. App users can save up to 20% on select hotels.

coupons.title: 10%+ off with free One Key Member Prices
coupons.description: Join the free One Key loyalty program to unlock Member Prices with discounts of 10% or more on select hotels and car rentals across 500,000+ properties.

coupons.title: 10% off promo code for email signup
coupons.description: Sign up for Hotwire's email list to get a 10% off promo code sent instantly to your inbox.

coupons.title: 10% off Hotel Express Deals in the app with code RMN10APP526
coupons.description: Apply code RMN10APP526 to save 10% off Hotel Express Deals when booking through the Priceline mobile app while signed in.

coupons.title: Extra 7% off Hotel Express Deals with code RMN7HTL426
coupons.description: Apply code RMN7HTL426 to take an extra 7% off Hotel Express Deals on Priceline.

coupons.title: 10% student discount on tours and experiences
coupons.description: Students get a permanent 10% discount on Tripadvisor bookings after verifying through Student Beans, and it often stacks with other promotions.

coupons.title: 20% off when booking a new listing
coupons.description: Vrbo offers 20% off your stay when you book from one of its newly listed properties, an ongoing incentive that helps new property owners increase bookings.
